title: Geller 2019 radio interview: Puharich drugged him with mushrooms and hypnosis

tellings.quote: on a radio show in like 2019 saying that Puharich had experimented on him with with mushrooms

plain: Uri Geller is said to have claimed, on a radio show around 2019, that a man named Puharich had experimented on him with mushrooms and with hypnosis. A researcher named Greg Malatzi passes this on to Michels as something Geller said in public, without naming the show. If true, it would mean Geller's early experiences were shaped by drugs and hypnosis given to him by the man studying him.
